name: Ticket Source Import and Reconciliation
foundation_dependencies: LLD-02 Customer/Contact exact matching and setting-definition interfaces
LLD-03 SR/RFC identity, accepted source projection, hierarchy, relationships and lifecycle mutation interfaces
LLD-05 WFM/Task source-projection and operational-plan mutation interfaces
LLD-06 typed SLA consumer contract for accepted SR Report Date/severity/status/suspension/Customer context
scope: shared ticket workbook import framework across Advanced Search SR, Enhanced RFC and Service Provider WFM
separate Advanced Search inbox setting plus shared RFC/WFM import directory semantics
smallest-safe-scope reconciliation proposals/dispositions and explicit older/equal-chronology recovery
Advanced Search SR identity/source-field/disappearance/reference reconciliation proposals into LLD-03/02
not_owned_here: SR/RFC authoritative current lifecycle, SR identity and accepted current source projection -> LLD-03
final canonical SR Customer/Contact relationship authority -> cross-packet LLD-02/03 closure currently required
WFM/Task identity/current source projection/operational plan/Objective consequences -> LLD-05
Customer/Contact master identity and affiliation lifecycle -> LLD-02
transaction_boundaries: Workbook discovery, stabilization, security validation, parsing, normalization, fingerprinting and proposal calculation occur outside authoritative domain mutation transactions.
Unpublished validating-run staging may use bounded technical transactions but has no source/review/domain authority until complete atomic publication.
Every accepted reconciliation proposal uses exactly one outer LLD-01 UnitOfWork and one command receipt; owner services participate in that same UnitOfWork and never commit independently.
Run finalization and source-checkpoint update are atomic; recovery authorization/disposition is append-only and never itself fabricates SR/RFC/WFM/Task authority.
failure_modes: unsafe, unstable, inaccessible, malformed or unsupported workbook candidate fails visibly without silent fallback to older candidate
Advanced Search manual selection lacking supported source-population chronology may be safely previewed but cannot publish/checkpoint/mutate operational authority
partial/interrupted staging remains unpublished and cannot establish source presence/replay/proposals/checkpoint
identity/header/content ambiguity blocks only smallest safe scope unless workbook-level integrity makes the source inseparable
proposal acceptance fails closed on stale proposal/base-state/reference-generation/lifecycle/plan state
Advanced Search Customer/Contact unresolved identity never becomes guessed relationship and does not block independently valid SR source facts
cross-domain nested commit/partial mutation/checkpoint disagreement rolls back through shared UnitOfWork
review_evidence: Prior RFC/WFM construction remains preserved and is not semantically reopened.
V2 audit found Advanced Search SR source intake requirements had no implementation owner.
Construction is deliberately reopened to extend the existing import framework instead of creating a parallel importer.
First Advanced Search checkpoint pins source profile/header/field/time semantics, parser rules, reconciliation proposal classes and acceptance scenarios.
known_unresolved_blockers: Wire advanced_search_sr through common import source-family schema/enums, discovery, commands, routes, interfaces, observations and proposal persistence.
Resolve how population-disappearance review is persisted because current reconciliation proposal schema requires a current source_observation_id while omission has no current row.
Pin canonical current Service Request Customer Organization resolution authority shared by LLD-03 and LLD-06.
Pin persistent or derived Contact association semantics for Customer Contact and Current Handler without creating competing handler authority.
Replace LLD-03 sr_source_field_observations.source_evidence_id placeholder with exact LLD-04 published source evidence FK/interface.
Complete V2 DTO/audit/job/migration/implementation/traceability closure before review_ready is restored.
design_principle: Every workbook is untrusted immutable source evidence first. Shared discovery/security/fingerprint/recovery mechanics are reused across source families, while accepted entity changes cross only exact owning-domain interfaces. Advanced Search source labels and handler text remain evidence rather than relational identity.
